title: THE TOWN LINE — A seat for the next generation
current_direction: Model meets matching-outfit mascot during a wordless commercial train ride through Signature, Black Rose, Love Hurts and Kids.

source_policy.archive: Collection look and identity research, not exact product construction authority
source_policy.model: Exact verified front; Kids-002 uses verified product-card-alt from main checkout
source_policy.generated: Candidate only; normalize mascot garment differences before two-character scenes
source_policy.wordless: No added verbal messaging. Existing product lettering preserved.

train.geometry: One consistent train: black curved shell, broad rounded windows at fixed spacing, straight center aisle, inward-facing seats, two-panel opaque internal doors, restrained overhead rails. Collection material/light changes per carriage; same scale and camera travel.
train.continuity: Camera advances left-to-right along the train. Window parallax stays in one direction. Cut behind opaque internal door jambs to change the mascot's collection outfit; never morph clothes in view. Only one Skyy per shot.
train.formats: Native 9:16 master blocking; compose both faces and product fronts within the central 80% width, keep critical detail clear of top 10% and bottom 18%. Separate 16:9 camera blocking, never blind crop.
train.hero_policy: Use only the selected source-derived piece, keep the whole story inside the moving train, and preserve exact recognizable shapes. Hero reference is environment-only, never a cast/wardrobe reference. Added captions/title monuments are excluded; original garment text remains.

pairs.name: The Sherpa Jacket
pairs.correction: Preserve the open black shell, white fleece lining, collar and exact red chest rose from the product/model. Archive embroidery is simplified. Cream trousers and sneakers are mascot styling, not additional matched SKUs.
pairs.world: Warm gold reflected off brushed brass, dark walnut window surrounds, broad daylight through Bay Bridge steel trusses. An inviting observation carriage with tactile black seating. Gold belongs to architecture and reflection; neutral light preserves black shell and white fleece.
pairs.gesture: The model notices the same red rose on Skyy's jacket and his own, then opens a hand toward the free place beside him.

pairs.name: BLACK Rose Hoodie
pairs.correction: Match the complete botanical rose/cloud artwork and its relative scale to the product front. Preserve black drawstrings, kangaroo pocket and cuffs. Do not import the archive's blue background or treat mascot joggers as a matched SKU.
pairs.world: Black metal carriage ribs, brushed silver rails, dark reflective windows, a restrained black rose at the window ledge. Bridge shadows pass over matte surfaces. Silver practical edge light, no blue or teal, no storm, no smoke machine.
pairs.gesture: The Black Rose model holds the internal carriage door for Skyy; she pauses beside him and gives a small appreciative nod.

pairs.world: Crimson upholstery, dark carved window arches that echo the collection rose-window geometry, one real red rose in a fixed small vase. Moving red reflections remain on the walls while neutral soft light keeps the jacket white. No candles on a moving train.
pairs.gesture: The model shifts an open hand toward an empty seat. Skyy looks from the offered seat to him; the matching red script makes their connection legible.

pairs.name: Kids Colorblock Hoodie Set — Red/Black

common_image_prompt: Make a single continuous cinematic frame for a wordless 30-second SkyyRose fashion commercial aboard the Town Line. The human must be the exact photographic model from the supplied verified front image; preserve their face, hair, age appearance and proportions. Skyy must be the same stylized 3D mascot from the supplied collection-look reference, corrected to the verified garment references. Keep the two identities distinct. Do not make the human cartoon or Skyy photorealistic. Source hierarchy: verified product/front image governs construction, panels, marks and colors; canonical mascot governs face, hair, proportions; corrected collection-look anchor governs her accepted outfit; accepted carriage anchor governs scene continuity. Never let archived background or incorrect garment details override these sources. Physically grounded shadows, coherent eyelines and train perspective. No added words, captions, narration, lyrics, announcements, title cards, call-to-action or signage. Preserve existing garment lettering; do not erase, rewrite or add it. No new products, duplicated cast, fashion-card layout, split screen, floating products, giant roses, magic wardrobe changes, strobe, fast orbit or generic runway posing.

shots.camera: 35mm, camera at the adult's chest height; medium two-shot; slow 20cm push.
shots.image: Inside the moving Signature carriage, the exact adult model occupies center-left and Skyy, in her corrected matching Sherpa outfit, center-right. Frame both faces and jacket fronts clearly from the first image. Skyy has just entered the aisle and is looking up at the model; he is noticing her. Passing bridge trusses are visible through the side window. Set feet firmly on the carriage floor. No exterior establishing shot. HERO INTEGRATION: Place a faithful, scaled architectural relief of the hero's sculpted rose in the upper window divider behind the pair. Its warm metallic edge catches the passing light. Keep it in the carriage background and clear of both jacket roses. Do not import the entire hero sky, skyline or word monument.
shots.motion: For three seconds Skyy raises her eyes toward the adult; he looks from her red chest rose to her face. Gentle carriage sway only; keep both torsos front-facing. Camera pushes 20cm. Finish on mutual recognition.
shots.sound: A crisp carriage-door click starts the rail rhythm; bass pulse enters immediately.
shots.transition: Straight cut on the adult's glance.
shots.product: Both open jackets and red roses visible immediately.

shots.camera: 50mm, slight lower height for readable paired jacket fronts; no extreme macro.
shots.image: Continue the same accepted Signature scene with unchanged cast, scale, lighting and outfit details. The adult extends an open hand toward the empty place beside him. Skyy smiles slightly. Keep both red rose details and fleece edges readable in one continuous image, with background softened. HERO INTEGRATION: Place a faithful, scaled architectural relief of the hero's sculpted rose in the upper window divider behind the pair. Its warm metallic edge catches the passing light. shots.sound: A short fabric movement and rail clack land on the cut.
shots.transition: Full door-jamb occlusion permits the cut to the next collection. No on-screen outfit morph.
shots.product: A sustained second view of the exact jacket construction.

shots.camera: 35mm, child-adult shared two-shot, slight low angle; camera glides out from an opaque foreground jamb.
shots.image: Inside the Black Rose carriage, reveal the exact BR-004 adult already holding an INTERNAL doorway fully open; his arm stays beside his body so the chest graphic is clear. Skyy, in her corrected BR-004 look, stands just inside the doorway facing him and camera. Preserve safe floor contact and at least an arm's length of space. A silver reflection defines black fabric against black metal. HERO INTEGRATION: Through the broad side window, the exact star/rose monument passes as a collection-world landmark, with the source Bay Bridge behind it. shots.motion: Begin with the door already open. The model holds his position and gives a slight welcoming nod; Skyy nods back. Only the camera slides 30cm past the foreground jamb. No walking through a closing door, no shoulder rotation, no animated chest graphic.
shots.sound: Low metal latch and a deeper rail pulse; same musical motif.
shots.transition: Cut on the nod, keeping left-to-right travel.
shots.product: Both complete rose/cloud chest graphics unobstructed.

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot; minimal motion, window reflections supply energy.
shots.image: Use the accepted Black Rose scene as continuity authority. The adult and Skyy stand near the window in three-quarter front, exchanging a small confident smile. Their black hoodies, silver graphics and different visual styles are clearly distinct. Passing bridge shadows make the carriage feel in motion. Do not import any blue from the archived mascot scene. shots.motion: Both shift their gaze toward the next door without turning torso or feet. A silver window reflection moves across the fixed carriage surfaces. Camera slides 40cm right behind an existing opaque foreground door jamb until it fully occludes the view; the jamb stays physically fixed.
shots.sound: Rail clacks become the edit rhythm, no added voice.
shots.transition: Opaque cut to crimson carriage. Outfit changes occur only between shots.
shots.product: Hold source artwork readable for at least two seconds.

shots.image: Inside the Love Hurts carriage, the exact hood-up human model and Skyy in the corrected button-front LH jacket face each other at slight angles while both garment fronts face camera. The model offers the empty window-side seat with one open hand. A real rose and crimson upholstery establish the collection. White jackets remain white under neutral face and garment light. No zipper on Skyy's jacket. HERO INTEGRATION: Adapt the exact arch outline to the internal carriage doorway, at believable train scale. Secure a small glass cloche with one red rose in a recessed shelf beyond the model/mascot. The rose's placement motivates the camera slide. Preserve the physical rose/cloche shape; exclude the cloaked figure, title monument and candles.
shots.motion: The model opens one hand toward the seat; Skyy looks at the offered space then back to him. No sitting action or jacket opening in this shot. Short lateral camera travel reveals the rose beside the window. Keep button rows and lettering stable.
shots.sound: A warmer harmonic layer joins the same beat; soft carriage rattle.
shots.transition: Cut on Skyy's gaze toward the far door.
shots.product: Button front, contrasting sleeves and exact script placement are central.

shots.camera: Forward-facing 35mm view from inside the train; gentle approach, no visible people.
shots.image: Show the closed internal door at the end of the Love Hurts carriage, framed by crimson upholstery and dark window arches. A slim warm rose-gold seam of light appears around the door. Side windows show bridge structure sliding past. Withhold the Kids outfits and characters. This is the same train, not a fantasy portal. shots.motion: Camera gently approaches the fixed closed door. During the last second its two panels begin to part by a few centimeters. Hard cut on that first opening movement to the next shot with doors already open. Do not require an opening panel to fill the frame. No people generated in this transition plate.
